description: This file defines the PersistableOrder class, which represents an order entity in a sales management system. The class extends OrderEntity and includes fields for customer information, order products, and shipping preferences, along with their corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: PersistableOrder
classes.description: A class representing an order that is persistable within the system, including customer details, products, and shipping options.

methods.name: setOrderProductItems
methods.description: Sets the list of products associated with the order.

methods.name: getOrderProductItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products associated with the order.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a customer with this order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: isShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Returns whether the order is set to ship to the billing address.

methods.name: setShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Sets whether the order should be shipped to the billing address.
